title: Dual frequency under a linear change
statement: Let $M$ be an invertible linear map on the length-$n$ vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $\gamma$ be a vector in that space. Define the dual frequency associated to $M$ and $\gamma$ to be the unique vector $\delta$ such that, for every vector $x$, $\delta\cdot x=\gamma\cdot M^{-1}x$, where the dot product is over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: An invertible linear map on the length-$n$ vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$
A vector $\gamma$ in that vector space
